title: The Cables Under the Ocean That Run the Internet

segments.text: Almost all the internet travels under the ocean.
Over ninety five percent of global data crosses the sea.
Not by satellites, but by cables.
Each one is about as thick as a garden hose.
And it carries light between continents.
So your messages abroad likely cross the seabed.
Follow for daily tech and AI news.

description: Most of the internet runs through cables on the ocean floor. Follow for daily tech news!
